newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CSFB starts Novartis coverage with "buy".
newsitem.headline: CSFB starts Novartis coverage with "buy".

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston said it had initiated coverage of Novartis with a buy recommendation.

It cited expectations for immense value creation due to rapidly expanding return on invested capital, noting ROIC for pharmaceuticals should equal current levels for Pfizer, Merck & Co and Johnson & Johnson in 1998.

It also praised Novartis' strong agribusiness, but added the only "black spot" was nutrition, which it said was "destroying value". Novartis registered shares were up two Swiss francs to 1,887 at 0900 GMT.
CSFB set a 12-month price target of 2,200 francs for Novartis share and of $75 for ADRs.
